messages:
nina: FYI: EU late ingest for 2026-03-22 02:00-03:00 UTC (~18m). Affects hourly aggregates. Looking for a low-friction recompute path that won't exhaust shared quotas.
carl: can we target shards eu-rc-01 + eu-rc-02 only? estimate first then dry-run. prefer reserved-eu pool if SRE okays.
zed: note: need invalidate_prefix_cache flag when doing tenant-level recomputes to avoid double-counting. also report_affected_prefixes for idempotency.
nina: agree. SRE pinged: @sre-oncall please approve reserved pool for a short targeted recompute.
ops-bot: request recorded: req=recov-20260322-02, status=pending.
carl: operator script I'll add to runbook (trimmed):
```
# estimate
curl -s -X POST https://internal-console/api/recompute/estimate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP" \
  -d '{"shards":["eu-rc-01","eu-rc-02"],"from":"2026-03-22T02:00:00Z","to":"2026-03-22T03:00:00Z"}'
# dry-run
curl -s -X POST https://internal-console/api/recompute/dry_run \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP" \
  -d '{"shards":["eu-rc-01"],"options":{"invalidate_cache":true}}'
# run (canary)
curl -s -X POST https://internal-console/api/recompute/run \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP" \
  -d '{"shards":["eu-rc-01"],"priority":"canary","max_parallel":1,"route_pool":"reserved-eu"}'
```
zed: also add guard: auto-abort if estimate_units > 6000. and block priority=bypass without `sre_override` header.
nina: filing small UX ticket to show estimated token units and selected route_pool in recompute modal (UX-1309).
ops-bot: estimate complete: est=est-20260322-eu02, units=3880.
carl: est ok. dry-run queued.
ops-bot: dry-run done: dr=dr-20260322-eu02, simulated_writes=0, reported_prefixes=[tenant:globex/*].
zed: canary go. watch `agg-hours-delta` metric, abort if >1%.
ops-bot: job queued: job=rb-11021 (shard=eu-rc-01, pool=reserved-eu, priority=canary).
ops-bot: job succeeded: rb-11021 completed, delta=0.35%, writes=1120, prefixes_reported=tenant:globex/*.
carl: ramping to eu-rc-02 with max_parallel=2.
ops-bot: ramp job succeeded: rb-11022 completed, total_units=4025, final_delta=0.27%. archived estimate and run notes.
nina: thanks all — will update runbook and close after UX ticket lands.
